mapper.select: SELECT id, version_key, status, max_parallelism, configuration_json, created_by, created_at, activated_at FROM agent_configuration_version WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY activated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, version_key, status, max_parallelism, configuration_json, created_by, created_at, activated_at FROM agent_configuration_version WHERE version_key = #{versionKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_configuration_version ( version_key, status, max_parallelism, configuration_json, created_by, created_at, activated_at ) VALUES ( #{versionKey}, #{status}, #{maxParallelism}, #{configurationJson}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{activatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_configuration_version SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
